# paper-finder-student-mcp

> Search scholarly papers, find open access copies and related work through OpenAlex. No key needed. Free and open source MCP server for AI apps (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Copilot and others).

## Setup
- Run with npx -y paper-finder-student-mcp
- No key or account. Optional OPENALEX_EMAIL for OpenAlex's polite pool.
- Papers are identified by DOI (10.xxxx/yyy) or OpenAlex id (W followed by digits).

## Tools
- search_papers
- get_paper
- get_paper_by_doi
- find_open_access_pdf
- related_papers
- get_related_work
- cited_by
- list_author_papers

Each tool description states its inputs and one example prompt.
